labelNotes: Abs max voltage rows: Supply VS 6 V; Analog inputs IN+/IN- common-mode 40 V; VBUS pin 40 V; SDA, SCL, ALERT 6 V; A0/A1 'VS + 0.3' skipped. Identical (value, unit, qualifier) readings collapse, leaving 6 V (cited on Supply, VS) and 40 V (cited on Analog inputs; VBUS pin also prints 40). Including the analog-input/VBUS 40 V rows as 'input voltage' rows is a judgement call. pin_input_leakage ABSENT: the only leakage on these pages is 'Input leakage' (IN+ pin)+(IN- pin) in power-down mode, 0.1 TYP / 0.5 MAX uA, and IB input bias 17 uA - both on the analog current-sense pins, excluded per the guide. Supply current (IQ) is not on the selected pages. VCM 0-36 V is a common-mode input range, not a supply.
